### About

This tab demonstrates a simple Quarto + Shiny app that draws a histogram from random normal values.
Use the slider in the **App** tab to change the number of observations.

```{r}
#| context: server
output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
  hist(rnorm(input$obs))
})
```
